trigger: Triggers when entering the basement gear storage room where Tushar is pinned.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: KEEP THEM AWAY! THEY'RE SMASHING KEYBOARDS WITH NO STORY STRUCTURE!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Tushar, calm down, dost. They're just infinite monkeys generating content.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: I HATE MONKEYS! Behen di tang, they're typing infinite gibberish on my monitors!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, I gave them a 10-minute keynote pitch, but they only want bananas. Tragic.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Prabhu, shaanttt hojaaa. Fine, I'll do it myself. Step aside, let's frame this.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Tushar joined! His clapperboard freezes reality! Swap to him to hold the shot!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Rolling sound, rolling camera... and ACTION! Don't trip on my cables.
